text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list known as the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe features from the customer's point of view. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and solve problems. This iterative development approach helps teams adapt to changes, deliver value faster, and improve their work continuously.
